subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Finovate (post-discovery)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + stakeholder map request

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the candid discussion about your latency and cost pain points for the new instant-payments feature. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Priority problems: long tail latency on peak days, token cost growth with longer context, and legal/procurement questions around data residency.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: predictable p95 latency, predictable per-request unit economics, and controls for auditability.
- What we can do: run a short performance baseline on a representative payload, propose a dedicated capacity config for production (if you want isolation), and share SOC2 & data residency details.

Could you do two favors:
1) Share a quick stakeholder map (names/roles) for folks involved in the purchasing decision (economic buyer, procurement, legal/security owners, and the engineering champion).
2) Confirm your procurement timeline and any required contract terms (standard PO, SOW, or redlines we should expect).

I put Mateo (SE) on copy — he can scope a short technical baseline and prepare a champion enablement deck we can share internally.

Attachments: I’ll send a slim solution brief and a short champion playbook in the follow-up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Marissa — thanks for the materials. Quick notes from procurement:

- Standard steps: NDA (if needed) -> SOW/Early eval agreement -> PO for paid pilot -> Contract (annual) if we move to production.
- PO thresholds: anything under $50k we can issue on standard terms; above that requires finance review and CFO approval (Jason).
- Redlines: Legal typically pushes back on data residency & indemnity clauses. They requested our SOC2 report and any encryption/KMS details up front (cc'd legal).
- Timeline: We can start an evaluation as soon as we have an eval SOW. Expect 2 weeks for procurement/PO processing for pilots under $50k.

Ben
